task.title: Make dev single-VM and staging dual-VM topology explicit
task.summary_zh: 把 dev default compose 保持 single-VM baseline 但把 staging contract 明確收斂成 VM1 control/BFF 與 VM2 execution/broker 分離。補 compose config、env example、runbook 與 smoke，避免 default compose 被誤解成 staging topology。
acceptance: docker compose config 能分別驗證 dev/control/exec/staging；staging 文件與 env 明確要求 control VM 與 execution VM 分離；default compose 只標示 dev baseline
task.next: Finalized split staging contract in commit 73afde0. Verified validate_split_topology, dev/control/exec/staging compose config renders, script syntax, nonprod deploy dry-runs, workflow YAML parse, and staged diff check. Review approved by Claude; VM1 remains control/non-execution only and VM2 owns execution/broker secrets.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：四組 compose 配置獨立可驗證；staging VM1/VM2 分離在 compose、env、文件層均明確執行；default compose 清楚標示為 dev single-VM baseline；validate_split_topology.sh 覆蓋所有必要斷言
後續追蹤：健康端點不一致（/health、/__health__、/readyz）已在 SVC-BLUEPRINT-OBSERVABILITY-PROBE-FINALIZE 處理，非本任務 blocker

handoffs.message: Auto-reassigned SVC-BLUEPRINT-STAGING-DUALVM-CONTRACT away from sidecar-only lane Gemini; owner Gemini -> Codex2. Reserved sidecar-only agents no longer hold mainline tasks.

Ready for review: staging-full is VM1 non-execution overlay with no VM1 broker/runtime/execution services or broker/exchange/provider secrets; validation covers dev/control/exec/staging renders. Verified: bash scripts/validate_split_topology.sh; docker compose config --quiet for docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.control.yml, docker-compose.exec.yml, and control+staging-full; bash -n scripts/validate_split_topology.sh scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh; deploy_nonprod_vm staging-live/all --dry-run; jq checks for forbidden staging services/secrets.

Review approved: dev single-VM baseline and staging dual-VM split contract correctly enforced at compose, env, and doc layers. All four configs render independently. VM1 excludes all execution/broker services and secrets. Default compose labeled as dev-only baseline. Validation script covers all required assertions. Return to owner for finalization.
